artifacts.summary: Eight-phase Wave 0 hotfix plan covering the simp loop, C6 unreachable modules, the Bundle/Algebraic cycle, four documentation fronts, and a final acceptance gate.

memory_candidates.content: When decomposing a multi-front hotfix in a Lean/Lake repo, distinguish logical dependencies from shared-build-resource contention. Phases touching disjoint .lean files often have no Depends-on relationship at all, but each needs its own `lake build`, and running them concurrently makes a build failure unattributable. Record `Depends on: none` truthfully (so the wave table stays honest) and add a separate execution note serializing the build-consuming phases smallest-blast-radius-first. Modeling the build lock as a fake dependency chain misstates what blocks what and prevents genuinely parallel doc-only phases from being recognized as parallel.
